title: The Locked Library
intro:
**Welcome to The Locked Library.**

You wake up on a cold wooden floor. The door is locked, the windows are bricked up, and a single lamp flickers over the room. You can make out a **desk**, a **bookshelf**, a **painting**, a **grandfather clock** and the **door** with its glowing four-digit keypad.

Type what you want to do in plain English, e.g. *"examine the desk"*, *"take the key"*, *"try 1234 on the drawer"*. Type **help**, **hint**, **inventory** or **restart** at any time.
help: Describe what you want to do in plain English: examine objects, take items, use items on objects, enter four-digit codes (e.g. 'try 1234 on the drawer') or open the door. Commands: look around, inventory, hint, restart.

examine.text: A heavy oak desk with a leather blotter. On it lie a magnifying glass and a handwritten note that reads: 'The red books speak in a language too small for the eye. Their numbers open the drawer.'
A tall bookshelf crammed with dusty volumes. Four red books are arranged differently from the rest, as if someone wanted them noticed.
The four red books sit side by side. Faded handwriting runs along their spines, far too small to read with the naked eye.

needs_item.text: Through the magnifying glass you can read a tiny handwritten number on each spine. From left to right: 3, 8, 1, 5.

examine.text: A gloomy painting of a stormy sea. The frame hangs slightly crooked. Behind it you discover a small wall safe with a keyhole.
A small steel wall safe set into the plaster. It has a keyhole and no dial.

flag_texts.safe_open: The safe stands open. Inside is a folded note: 'The way out begins with 6 and 2. The rest, the clock still remembers.'

examine.text: A grandfather clock whose pendulum hangs motionless. It has stopped at exactly 4:00: the hour hand points to 4 and the minute hand to 0.
A sturdy desk drawer, locked. Instead of a keyhole it has a small four-digit dial.
A heavy oak door, firmly locked. Beside it a keypad waits for a four-digit code.

flag_texts.door_unlocked: The door is unlocked and ready to be opened.

magnifying_glass.name: magnifying glass
magnifying_glass.description: A brass-rimmed magnifying glass. It makes tiny writing readable.

brass_key.name: brass key
brass_key.description: A small brass key, cold to the touch.

clues.desk_note: Desk note: the red books hold numbers that open the drawer.
clues.books_digits: The four red books, left to right: 3, 8, 1, 5.
clues.safe_note: Safe note: the way out begins with 6 and 2; the clock remembers the rest.

drawer.locked_text: The drawer is locked. It has a four-digit dial.
drawer.fail_text: The dial clicks around but the drawer stays shut. That is not the right combination.

facts: The dial clicks into place and the drawer slides open. Inside lies a small brass key.

safe.locked_text: The wall safe is locked. It has a small keyhole.

facts: The key turns and the safe door swings open. Inside is a folded note: 'The way out begins with 6 and 2. The rest, the clock still remembers.'

door.locked_text: The door is locked. A four-digit keypad glows beside it.
door.fail_text: The keypad buzzes angrily. That code is wrong.

facts: The keypad chimes green and the lock clicks open. The door is free to open.

exit_text: You push the heavy door open and cold night air rushes in. You are free!

desk: The desk is the most obvious place to start.
take_glass: Something on the desk could be useful to carry.
bookshelf: There is more to this room than the desk. Look at the shelves.
books: Some books are arranged differently. Tiny writing needs a closer look.
Examine the red books while carrying the magnifying glass.
drawer: Enter the numbers you found on the red books, left to right, on the drawer.
take_key: Something inside the open drawer may be worth taking.
painting: A crooked frame often hides something.
safe: You now have a key and there is a keyhole somewhere.
Try: use the key on the safe.
clock: The note in the safe mentions a clock.
door: You should now hold both halves of the exit code.
Combine the first two digits from the safe note with the time the clock stopped at, then enter all four on the door.
